summary: Digital Brands Group filed an 8-K on June 17, 2026, announcing the cancellation of 7.1 million pre-funded warrants amid a shareholder-initiated investigation into alleged collusion, beneficial ownership cap violations (4.99% rule), use of foreign nominees, and transfer agent discrepancies. The company acted to protect shareholders pending legal clarity, per a June 15 press release. No price, premium, or board recommendation was disclosed. The warrants had ownership blockers, suggesting structural safeguards. The situation involves corporate governance concerns rather than a transactional event. What to watch: outcome of the investigation and potential regulatory or shareholder actions.
